actions.name: CZML Writer
actions.description: Exporte les entités au format CZML pour la visualisation Cesium, avec prise en charge des entités dynamiques dans le temps et des positions de séries temporelles

parameterI18n.title: CZML Writer Parameters
parameterI18n.description:
Configuration for writing geographic features to CZML files. Supports both static entities and time-dynamic entities with interpolated position samples.

## Timeseries Configuration

To create time-animated entities in Cesium, configure at least the first two parameters below; configure `epoch` only when using numeric time offsets: 1. `timeField` - Attribute containing time values 2. `groupTimeseriesBy` - Attribute to group features into entities 3. `epoch` (optional) - Base time used when `timeField` contains numeric offsets

### Example with ISO 8601 timestamps: ```yaml - action: CZML Writer with: output: "vehicles.czml" timeField: "timestamp"           # Contains "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", etc. groupTimeseriesBy: "vehicleId"   # Groups by vehicle ID interpolationAlgorithm: "LAGRANGE" interpolationDegree: 5 ```

### Example with numeric time offsets: ```yaml - action: CZML Writer with: output: "sensors.czml" timeField: "timeOffset"          # Contains numeric values: 0, 60, 120, etc. groupTimeseriesBy: "sensorId" epoch: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"    # Base time for offsets interpolationAlgorithm: "LINEAR" ```

colorAttribute.title: Color Attribute
colorAttribute.description: Attribute containing a hex color string (e.g., "#ffd8c0") for polygon fill. Used when polygon geometry is auto-converted from the feature geometry.

epoch.title: Epoch
epoch.description:
Reference time (ISO 8601 format) used as the base for numeric time offsets.

**When to use:** - Optional but recommended when `timeField` contains numeric values (e.g., "0", "60", "3600") - Not needed when `timeField` contains ISO 8601 datetime strings

**Format:** ISO 8601 datetime string with timezone - Examples: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-06-15T09:00:00+09:00"

**Auto-detection:** If omitted and all time values are numeric, automatically defaults to Unix epoch "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z". For custom time ranges, explicitly set this parameter to your desired base time.

**Example:** ```yaml epoch: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"  # Time value "60" means 2024-01-01T00:01:00Z ```

groupBy.title: Group By Attributes
groupBy.description: Attributes used to group features into separate CZML files

groupTimeseriesBy.title: Group Timeseries By
groupTimeseriesBy.description: Attribute used to group features into a single time-dynamic CZML entity. Features with the same value for this attribute are merged into one packet with time-tagged positions.

heightAttribute.title: Height Attribute
heightAttribute.description: Attribute containing a numeric value for polygon extrusion height. When set, polygons are extruded from ground to this height value.

interpolationAlgorithm.title: Interpolation Algorithm
interpolationAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used by Cesium to interpolate between time-tagged samples.

interpolationDegree.title: Interpolation Degree
interpolationDegree.description: Degree of interpolation (1 for LINEAR, 5 typical for LAGRANGE).

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Alpha value (0–255) for polygon fill color. Default: 180.

output.title: Output File Path
output.description: Path where the CZML file will be written

timeField.title: Time Field
timeField.description:
Attribute containing the timestamp for each feature. Supports two formats: - **ISO 8601 strings**: e.g., "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-01-01T12:30:45+09:00" - **Numeric values**: Seconds as offset from epoch (e.g., "0", "60", "120.5")

When set together with `groupTimeseriesBy`, features sharing the same group key are combined into a single CZML entity with time-tagged position samples for animation in Cesium.

**Example workflow configuration:** ```yaml - action: CZML Writer with: output: "output.czml" timeField: "timestamp" groupTimeseriesBy: "vehicleId" epoch: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"  # Optional for numeric times (auto-defaults to Unix epoch) ```

HERMITE.description: Hermite spline interpolation using tangent data.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange polynomial interpolation for smooth curves (typical degree 5).

parameterI18n.title: Geometry Replacer Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configure which attribute holds the geometry that replaces the feature's current geometry.

sourceAttribute.title: Source Attribute
sourceAttribute.description: Attribute holding the compressed geometry to apply, as written by Geometry Extractor. The attribute is removed once its geometry has been applied, and a feature that does not carry it passes through unchanged. A feature whose stored geometry cannot be decoded is sent to the rejected port.

actions.name: Geometry Splitter
actions.description: Split Multi-Geometries into Individual Features

parameterI18n.title: Geometry Splitter Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configure how multi-part geometries are split into individual features.

groupBy.title: Group By
groupBy.description: Attribute key to group split members by. Members sharing the same value for this attribute are kept together in a single output feature instead of being split into separate ones; members lacking the attribute are still emitted individually.

actions.name: Geometry Validator
actions.description: Validate Feature Geometry Quality

parameterI18n.title: Geometry Validator Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configure which validation checks to perform on feature geometries.

degenerateThresholds.title: Degeneracy Thresholds
degenerateThresholds.description: Minimum length / area / volume below which the degeneracy check flags a geometry, per dimension. Each defaults to zero, flagging only an exactly-zero measure. Values are in the coordinate unit (the frame's linear unit, e.g. metres).

disabledOptionalChecks.title: Disabled Optional Checks
disabledOptionalChecks.description: Advisory checks to disable. Disabled checks do not run and are treated as passing; core validity checks always run. Empty by default, so every optional check runs.

duplicateTolerance.title: Duplicate Point Tolerance
duplicateTolerance.description: Optional distance within which two coordinates count as duplicates for the duplicate-points check. Omitted (the default) means exact-equality detection.

planarityThreshold.title: Planarity Threshold
planarityThreshold.description: Optional override for how the planarity check bounds a face's out-of-plane deviation: a scale-invariant `ratio` (the default), or an absolute `maxHeight` in the frame's linear unit (linear-unit frames only).

minArea.title: Minimum Area
minArea.description: Smallest area a 2D geometry (face or ring) may have before it is flagged.

minLength.title: Minimum Length
minLength.description: Shortest length a 1D geometry (line or ring edge) may have before it is flagged.

minVolume.title: Minimum Volume
minVolume.description: Smallest volume a 3D geometry (solid) may have before it is flagged.

duplicatePoints.title: Duplicate Points
duplicatePoints.description: Detection of coordinates that repeat within the geometry.

orientable.title: Orientable
orientable.description: Detection of surfaces whose faces cannot be given a consistent orientation.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Detection of rings wound in the wrong direction.

shellOrientation.title: Shell Orientation
shellOrientation.description: Detection of solid shells whose faces point the wrong way.

actions.name: Geometry Value Filter
actions.description: Filter Features by Geometry Value Type

actions.name: Grid Divider
actions.description: Divise les polygones en cellules de grille régulières

parameterI18n.title: Grid Divider Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configure the size of the grid cells and how features are grouped onto a shared grid.

cellSize.title: Cell Size
cellSize.description: Side length of each grid cell, in the same units as the geometry coordinates. Must be greater than zero.

completeCellsOnly.title: Complete Cells Only
completeCellsOnly.description: Whether to emit only cells that are whole, discarding the partial cells left where the grid meets the edge of a geometry. Defaults to false.

groupBy.title: Group By Attributes
groupBy.description: Attributes whose values group features together. Each group is divided on its own grid origin, derived from that group's combined bounds.

actions.name: HTTP Caller
actions.description: Appeler un point de terminaison HTTP ou HTTPS pour chaque entité et stocker la réponse dans les attributs de l'entité

parameterI18n.title: HTTP Caller Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configure the HTTP request made for each feature and how the response is stored

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Authentication method and credentials for the request

customHeaders.title: Custom Headers
customHeaders.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in the request

httpOptions.title: HTTP Options
httpOptions.description: HTTP client behavior settings (SSL verification, redirects, user agent)

method.title: HTTP Method
method.description: The HTTP method to use for the request (default: GET)

queryParameters.title: Query Parameters
queryParameters.description: URL query parameters to append to the request

rateLimit.title: Rate Limiting
rateLimit.description: Rate limiting configuration to control request frequency

requestBody.title: Request Body
requestBody.description: The body content to send with the request

response.title: Response Configuration
response.description: Configure how the response is stored on the feature

retry.title: Retry Configuration
retry.description: Settings for automatic retry on failures

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL to request, evaluated for each feature (supports expressions). Only http and https URLs are allowed, and requests to private or internal network addresses are blocked.

name.title: Field Name
name.description: The name of the form field

value.title: Field Value
value.description: The value of the form field (supports expressions)

name.title: Header Name
name.description: The name of the HTTP header

value.title: Header Value
value.description: The value of the header (supports expressions)

followRedirects.title: Follow Redirects
followRedirects.description: Whether to automatically follow HTTP redirects (default: true)

maxRedirects.title: Max Redirects
maxRedirects.description: Maximum number of redirects to follow (default: 10)

userAgent.title: User Agent
userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent header value sent with each request

verifySsl.title: Verify SSL
verifySsl.description: Whether to verify SSL/TLS certificates; disable only for servers with self-signed certificates (default: true)

name.title: Parameter Name
name.description: The name of the query parameter

value.title: Parameter Value
value.description: The value of the parameter (supports expressions)

intervalMs.title: Interval
intervalMs.description: Time interval in milliseconds for the rate limit (default: 1000)

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within the interval

timing.title: Timing Strategy
timing.description: How to distribute requests within the interval (default: burst)

autoDetectEncoding.title: Auto Detect Encoding
autoDetectEncoding.description: Choose text or base64 storage from the response's Content-Type header when Response Encoding is not set (default: true)

maxResponseSize.title: Max Response Size
maxResponseSize.description: Maximum response body size in bytes; the download is stopped and the feature rejected when a response exceeds it (unlimited if not set)

responseBodyAttribute.title: Response Body Attribute
responseBodyAttribute.description: Feature attribute name to store the response body (default: `_response_body`)

responseEncoding.title: Response Encoding
responseEncoding.description: How to store the response body: as UTF-8 text or as a base64-encoded string. When omitted, the encoding is chosen from the response's Content-Type header.

responseHandling.title: Response Handling
responseHandling.description: Whether to store the response body in a feature attribute or save it to a file (default: attribute)

backoffMultiplier.title: Backoff Multiplier
backoffMultiplier.description: Multiplier for exponential backoff between retries (default: 2.0)

honorRetryAfter.title: Honor Retry-After Header
honorRetryAfter.description: Whether to respect the Retry-After response header, in seconds or HTTP-date form, when scheduling a retry (default: true)

initialDelayMs.title: Initial Delay
initialDelayMs.description: Initial delay in milliseconds before the first retry (default: 100)

maxAttempts.title: Max Attempts
maxAttempts.description: Maximum total number of attempts including the initial request; 1 disables retries (default: 3)

maxDelayMs.title: Max Delay
maxDelayMs.description: Maximum delay in milliseconds between retries, also capping delays requested by the Retry-After header (default: 10000)

retryOnStatus.title: Retry on Status Codes
retryOnStatus.description: HTTP status codes that trigger a retry, such as [429, 503]. When omitted, all 5xx status codes are retried.

connectionTimeout.title: Connection Timeout
connectionTimeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to establish a connection (default: 60)

transferTimeout.title: Transfer Timeout
transferTimeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to complete the entire request (default: 90)

header.title: Header
header.description: Include API key in HTTP header

query.title: Query Parameter
query.description: Include API key in URL query string

base64.title: Base64
base64.description: Store the response body as a base64-encoded string (for binary data)

text.title: Text
text.description: Store the response body as UTF-8 text

burst.title: Burst
burst.description: Allow all requests immediately, then pause until next interval

distributed.title: Distributed
distributed.description: Evenly distribute requests throughout the interval

takeLast.title: Take Last

actions.name: Line On Line Overlayer
actions.description: Découpe les lignes à leurs croisements, enregistre sur chaque segment obtenu le nombre de lignes d'entrée qui le parcourent et émet chaque croisement comme une entité ponctuelle. Les entrées doivent être des géométries 2D planes, sans altitude, partageant un même référentiel de coordonnées ; placez un Two Dimension Forcer ou un Coordinate Frame Reprojector en amont pour les aplatir ou les unifier.

parameterI18n.title: Line On Line Overlayer Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Sets which lines are crossed against each other, how far apart two vertices may be and still count as one, and what the resulting segments record about the lines they came from.

groupBy.title: Group By Attributes
groupBy.description: Attributes whose values decide which lines are crossed against each other — only lines matching on all of them are compared. When omitted, every line is crossed against every other.

listAttribute.title: List Attribute
listAttribute.description: Attribute that receives one entry per line running along the resulting segment, each holding that line's own attributes. When omitted, no list is written.

outputAttribute.title: Overlap Count Attribute
outputAttribute.description: Attribute that receives the number of input lines running along the resulting segment. Defaults to `overlayCount`.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Distance below which two vertices are treated as the same point, in the unit of the input's coordinate frame. It decides which crossings split a line, which crossings are the same crossing, and which segments coincide; segments shorter than it are dropped. Must be greater than zero, or no line is ever split.

actions.name: List Concatenator
actions.description: Joint la valeur d'un attribut de chaque élément d'un attribut de liste en une seule chaîne. Les éléments qui ne sont pas des paires clé-valeur, ou qui n'ont pas cet attribut, sont ignorés.

parameterI18n.title: List Concatenator Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Which list to read, which attribute to take from its elements, and where the result goes.

elementAttribute.title: Element Attribute
elementAttribute.description: Attribute to take from each element of the list. An element that is not a set of key-value pairs, or that does not carry this attribute, contributes nothing.

list.title: List
list.description: Attribute holding the list to read. A feature whose attribute is missing, or is not a list, passes through unchanged.

outputAttribute.title: Output Attribute
outputAttribute.description: Attribute the joined string is written to.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Text placed between consecutive values. Defaults to a comma.

actions.name: List Exploder
actions.description: Creates one feature per element of a list attribute, merging the element's key-value pairs into the feature's attributes and removing the source attribute. A feature whose attribute is missing, empty, or not a list of key-value pairs produces nothing and is rejected instead.

parameterI18n.title: List Exploder Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configures which list attribute is expanded into individual features.

sourceAttribute.title: Source Attribute
sourceAttribute.description: Attribute holding a list of key-value pairs, one entry per feature to create.

actions.name: List Indexer
actions.description: Copie les paires clé-valeur d'un élément d'un attribut de liste sur l'entité elle-même, en écrasant un attribut de même nom et en laissant le reste en place.

parameterI18n.title: List Indexer Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Which list to read, which of its elements to copy, and how to name what is copied.

copiedAttributePrefix.title: Copied Attribute Prefix
copiedAttributePrefix.description: Text placed before each copied attribute name. Omitted by default.

copiedAttributeSuffix.title: Copied Attribute Suffix
copiedAttributeSuffix.description: Text placed after each copied attribute name. Omitted by default.

index.title: Index
index.description: Position of the element to copy, counting from zero. A feature whose list is shorter than this, or whose element at this position is not a set of key-value pairs, passes through unchanged.

list.title: List
list.description: Attribute holding the list to read. A feature whose attribute is missing, or is not a list, passes through unchanged.

arrayMapSeparator.title: Array/Map Separator

colonToUnderscore.title: Colon to Underscore
colonToUnderscore.description: Replace colons in attribute keys (e.g., from XML Namespaces) with underscores

compressOutput.title: Compressed Output Path

layerName.title: Layer Name

maxZoom.title: Maximum Zoom

output.title: Output

skipUnexposedAttributes.title: Skip Unexposed Attributes

actions.name: Neighbor Finder
actions.description: Trouve les entités candidates les plus proches pour chaque entité de base basée sur la proximité spatiale

parameterI18n.title: Neighbor Finder Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configuration for finding spatial neighbors between base and candidate features.

attributePrefix.description: Prefix applied to transferred candidate attributes to avoid collisions.

attributesToTransfer.description: List of candidate attributes to transfer. Empty list means all attributes are transferred.

distanceAttribute.description: Name of the attribute to store the computed distance to the nearest neighbor.

distanceMetric.description: Method used to compute distance between two features.

maxDistance.description: Maximum distance threshold for matching. If None, no distance limit is applied. Units depend on the distanceMetric: native units for Euclidean, meters for Haversine.

mergeStrategy.description: Controls how multiple neighbors are represented on the output.

neighborIndexAttribute.description: Name of the attribute to store the neighbor index (0-based rank) when num_closest > 1 and merge_strategy is "repeatBase". Set to empty string to suppress.

numClosest.description: Number of closest neighbors to find per base feature. Must be >= 1.

euclidean2d.description: 2D Euclidean distance using X and Y coordinates. Z is ignored.

euclidean3d.description: 3D Euclidean distance using X, Y, and Z coordinates.

haversine.description:
Great-circle distance treating X as longitude (degrees) and Y as latitude (degrees). Output is in meters. Intended for WGS-84 inputs.

Note: Distance is computed between representative points (centroids). For accurate results, input features should be relatively small (e.g., buildings, local roads). Large geometries (e.g., countries, large water bodies) may produce inaccurate distances because their centroids may not represent their spatial extent well.

arrayAttributes.description: A single Base feature is emitted; each transferred attribute becomes an ordered array sorted by ascending distance.

closest.description: Only the single closest neighbor is merged onto the Base feature.

repeatBase.description: One output feature is emitted per neighbor. Base attributes are duplicated across all rows, mirroring FME's default multi-neighbor output.

mappings.title: Attribute Mappings
mappings.description: Per-attribute rules describing how each null-like attribute is replaced, removed, or created.

nullDefinition.title: Null Definition
nullDefinition.description: States treated as null-like: an explicit null value, a missing attribute, or an empty string. Defaults to null values and missing attributes.

attribute.title: Attribute

onMissing.title: On Missing
onMissing.description: Behavior when the attribute is absent and not treated as null-like by the null definition.

replacement.description: What to write when the attribute is null-like. Required, so that removing an attribute is stated rather than implied by leaving this out.

emptyString.title: Empty String

missing.title: Missing Attribute

null.title: Null Value

create.title: Create

listed.title: Listed Attributes
